shellCommands.command: ls -la && git log --stat | head -30 && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; head -40 package-lock.json; node --version

export DATA_FILE=/tmp/smoke/books.json PORT=3456; rm -rf /tmp/smoke
node server.js & PID=$!; sleep 0.5
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "add: %{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n" -d "title=The Hobbit&author=J.R.R. Tolkien&notes=Chapter 3 so far.%0ALoving it." localhost:3456/books
ID=$(node -e "console.log(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/tmp/smoke/books.json'))[0].id)")
curl -s localhost:3456/books/$ID | sed -n '/<body>/,$p'
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "finish: %{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n" -d "back=list" localhost:3456/books/$ID/finish
kill $PID; sleep 0.3
node server.js & PID=$!; sleep 0.5
echo "--- after restart:"; curl -s localhost:3456/ | sed -n '/<h2>Currently/,/<h2 id/p'
kill $PID; cat /tmp/smoke/books.json
